name: stationary_author_core_pdqn_20261101
scope: One fixed camera, one stationary target; active centering and zoom only
algorithm: Directly loaded pinned HAS-CAM PDQNAgent, Q_Actor, ParamNet, ReplayBuffer

learning.update_cadence: episode step indices 0,32,64,...; any later change requires a separate configuration
learning.epsilon: original epsilon(episode), .9 to .1 over first 300 episodes
learning.execution: clip selected parameter to Box and divide by 5; preserve raw parameters in Q and replay

input.profile: author state semantics retained: x,y,area*100,confidence,delayed action/6,original history-index duration,x trend,y trend
input.detection: frozen overhead v1 weights, threshold .15, imgsz960, FP32, existing full-and-half confidence NMS preprocessing
input.reid: frozen real VeRi SBS R50 IBN, 2048 dimensions

physics.difference: UE calibration; slower angular rates than author Table2, unchanged raw/5 duration mapping; perspective FOV rather than optical lens

task.difference_from_source: source reward targets .05 and stops after ten confidence>.9; this explicitly named engineering task uses geometric reward and 5 simulation seconds of stable closed-loop hold
task.reward: 20*(previous_image_cost-next_image_cost) -2*next_image_cost +.75*inner_quality -.02*nonStay; image_cost=center_norm+.3*abs(log(area/.04)); lost cost=3; inner_quality=center<=.02 and logscale<=.18; completion bonus +10, timeout -10

coverage.axes: Independent secondary offset and randomized dominant axis, no diagonal coupling
coverage.note: Full visibility margins limit permissible center offset for large boxes; actual initial boxes and image border gaps are reported
coverage.validation_and_test_FOV: intermediate ranges disjoint from training FOV ranges
coverage.test: Materialize once only after validation qualification; no tuning on final test

comparisons: Preserve historical source-math consistency evidence and frozen source checkpoint
Live source baseline on current overhead scene with calibrated mechanics
Same checkpoint and cases with confidence termination disabled only
Engineering reward/hold contract explicitly differs; original state and all four networks stay unchanged
Any cadence or representation experiment is separate, never overwritten or relabeled author-equivalent
